name: ryu.browser
description: A real-Chromium browser (Electron) Ryu runs as a local sidecar and exposes as the grant-gated `browser.control` capability: list/open/navigate tabs, screenshot, read titles, take an accessibility snapshot with stable element refs, and drive the page with synthetic click/type/scroll input. Core spawns the sidecar lazily and idle-stops it; the desktop Browser panel drives it through the ext-proxy.
